title: MiaoMiao Libre Bluetooth disconnected
body:
This evening I left my phone on my desk, and walked through to the kitchen for some time. Several 5 minute intervals would have been missed, and the bluetooth would have disconnected.

I returned to my desk for about 30 minutes before I checked my phone, and xDrip+ was reporting disconnected for 52 minutes, and failed to 'reawaken'.

I force close the app, restart and voila, it bounces back to life. Can I help debug why this has happened? I would be happy to provide any amount of information to help sort the problem

xDrip+ (android) version: b7fc030-2018.08.07
Code: 1808071559
Downgradeable to: 1603091400
Data source : Tomato
Bluetooth device : miaomiao

comments.body: i have had this issue awhile and find forgetting device and reconnecting it helps, there was a thread here before about this issue, i think it got closed.
hiya, tried that documents suggestions. i really thought enabling use scanning would help as the miao does appear to a normal bt scan but on the status it just says "scan failed!"
Can you please send a print of that status screen?

hi, the settings (screenshots) from @ahaverty on https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/628 might helped.  
My miaomiao was disconnecting and not reconnecting.  Seems to be all sorted now :).  So happy.

Please use the support channels to consult with the user community.
